blocks.en: 87 Mantle Cell Lymphoma — Ben-Niklas Baermann and Sascha Dietrich
blocks.zh: 87 套細胞淋巴瘤 — Ben-Niklas Baermann 和 Sascha Dietrich

blocks.en: Author affiliations: Department of Hematology, University Hospital of Düsseldorf, Düsseldorf, Germany. Correspondence: sascha.dietrich@med.uni-duesseldorf.de.
blocks.zh: 作者單位：德國杜塞爾多夫杜塞爾多夫大學醫院血液科。通訊地址：sascha.dietrich@med.uni-duesseldorf.de。

blocks.en: 87.1 Introduction Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is an aggressive B-cell lymphoma, which is characterized by the chromosomal translocation t(11;14)(q13;q32) and overexpression of cyclin D1 in the vast majority of cases. Most patients present with advanced stage disease often with extra-nodal dissemination. High Ki67 proliferation index (Hoster et al. 2016), blastoid histologic variant (Bernard et al. 2001), and TP53 mutations represent high-risk features at diagnosis (Eskelund et al. 2017).
blocks.zh: 87.1 簡介 套細胞淋巴瘤 (MCL) 是一種侵襲性 B 細胞淋巴瘤，其特徵是絕大多數病例中染色體易位 t(11;14)(q13;q32) 和細胞週期蛋白 D1 過度表達。大多數患者出現晚期疾病，通常伴隨結外播散。高 Ki67 增殖指數 (Hoster et al. 2016)、母細胞組織學變異 (Bernard et al. 2001) 和 TP53 突變代表診斷時的高風險特徵 (Eskelund et al. 2017)。

blocks.en: Front-line treatment of MCL has improved considerably, but success with chemotherapybased treatments of relapsed and refractory (R/R)
blocks.zh: MCL 的第一線治療已有顯著進步，但以化療為基礎的治療對復發／難治性（R/R）

blocks.en: MCL has been limited (Dreyling et al. 2017). A paradigm shift from chemoimmunotherapy to targeted- and cellular therapies, such as chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell treatment, is currently changing the dismal prognosis of R/R MCL.
blocks.zh: MCL 的成效有限（Dreyling et al. 2017）。目前正從化學免疫治療轉向標靶與細胞治療，例如嵌合抗原受體（CAR）T 細胞治療，因而改變 R/R MCL 原本不佳的預後。

blocks.en: 87.2 Autologous HCT During recent years, the prognosis of patients with MCL has improved considerably, and the refinement of dose-intensified approaches such as auto- HCT has contributed significantly to this development. A prospective randomized trial by the European Mantle Cell Lymphoma Network (EMCLN) has demonstrated the superiority of auto-HCT consolidation over interferon maintenance (Dreyling et al. 2005) in the pre-RTX era.
blocks.zh: 87.2 自體 HCT 近年 MCL 患者的預後大幅改善，自體 HCT 等劑量強化策略的精進對此貢獻良多。歐洲套細胞淋巴瘤網絡（EMCLN）的前瞻性隨機試驗顯示，在 RTX 問世前，自體 HCT 鞏固治療優於 interferon 維持治療（Dreyling et al. 2005）。

blocks.en: The introduction of RTX and the addition of highdose cytarabine (HD-ARAC) to the induction treatment before auto-HCT have further improved PFS and OS of MCL patients (Cheah et al. 2016; Geisler et al. 2008). The benefit of HD-ARAC before auto- HCT could be confirmed in prospective clinical trial (Hermine et al. 2016). The French study group conducted a prospective randomized phase III trial (LyMa trial) that investigated RTX maintenance versus observation after auto-HCT in previously untreated MCL patients. Final results of the LyMa trial confirmed the superiority of RTX maintenance with regard to PFS and OS (Le Gouill et al. 2017).
blocks.zh: RTX 的引入，以及在自體 HCT 前的誘導治療中加入高劑量 cytarabine（HD-ARAC），進一步改善 MCL 患者的 PFS 與 OS（Cheah et al. 2016；Geisler et al. 2008）。前瞻性臨床試驗亦證實自體 HCT 前使用 HD-ARAC 的效益（Hermine et al. 2016）。法國研究團隊進行 LyMa III 期前瞻性隨機試驗，比較先前未治療 MCL 患者於自體 HCT 後接受 RTX 維持治療或觀察；最終結果證實 RTX 維持治療在 PFS 與 OS 方面均較佳（Le Gouill et al. 2017）。

blocks.en: The beneficial effect of RTX maintenance was observed in both PETpositive and PET-negative patients after induction treatment prior to auto- HCT (Mei et al. 2017). This finding implies that the benefit of RTX maintenance after auto-HCT is present for low- and high-risk MCL patients (Dietrich et al. 2014b, Graf et al. 2015).
blocks.zh: 在自體 HCT 之前的誘導治療後，在 PET 陽性和 PET 陰性患者中觀察到 RTX 維持的有益效果 (Mei et al. 2017)。這項發現表明，自體 HCT 後進行 RTX 維持治療對於低風險和高風險 MCL 患者均具有益處（Dietrich 等人，2014b；Graf 等人，2015）。

blocks.en: Very recently, first results of the TRIANGLE study revealed that the addition of Ibrutinib to HD-ARAC induction followed by RTX and ibrutinib maintenance further improved first-line treatment of MCL (Dreyling et al. 2022). Ibrutinib with RTX- and HD-ARAC-based induction treatment can therefore be considered as the new
blocks.zh: 近期 TRIANGLE 研究的初步結果顯示，在 HD-ARAC 誘導治療加入 ibrutinib，之後再以 RTX 與 ibrutinib 維持，可進一步改善 MCL 第一線治療（Dreyling et al. 2022）。因此，ibrutinib 合併以 RTX 與 HD-ARAC 為基礎的誘導治療，可視為年輕且體能良好 MCL 患者的新

blocks.en: firstline standard treatment for young and fit MCL patients. A second experimental arm of the TRIANGLE study investigated ibrutinib and HD-ARAC induction treatment without auto- HCT consolidation. So far, it can be concluded that ibrutinib and HD-ARAC without auto-HCT is significantly better than HD-ARAC followed by auto-HCT. If the auto-HCT after ibrutinib and HD-ARAC induction can be omitted needs to be shown with longer follow-up of the TRIANLE study. In MIPI low-risk patients, however, it seems very unlikely that a consolidating auto- HCT further improves outcome. It seems also unlikely that TP53-mutated MCLs benefit from high-dose chemotherapy and auto-HCT. Auto- HCT in these two selected groups of MCL patients should therefore be critically discussed.
blocks.zh: 第一線標準治療。TRIANGLE 的第二個實驗組評估 ibrutinib 與 HD-ARAC 誘導而不接受自體 HCT 鞏固；目前可知，此方案優於 HD-ARAC 後接自體 HCT。ibrutinib 與 HD-ARAC 誘導後能否省略自體 HCT，仍須更長期追蹤。對 MIPI 低風險患者，自體 HCT 鞏固似乎不太可能再改善結果；TP53 突變 MCL 亦不太可能從高劑量化療與自體 HCT 獲益。因此，這兩類患者是否接受自體 HCT 應審慎討論。

blocks.en: 87.3 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy Although a significant proportion of patients with MCL enjoy long-term disease control after intensive first-line therapies, relapse remains the main cause of treatment failure. The prognosis of patients with MCL recurrence after auto-HCT appears to be extremely poor, especially if occurring early after transplant (Dietrich et al. 2011, 2014a). A proportion of almost 40% of MCL patients relapsing after auto-HCT were reported to suffer from chemotherapy-refractory disease (Dietrich et al. 2014a) with a high prevalence of clonal TP53 mutations (Halldorsdottir et al.
blocks.zh: 87.3 嵌合抗原受體 T 細胞治療 雖然相當比例的 MCL 患者在強化第一線治療後可長期控制疾病，復發仍是治療失敗的主因。自體 HCT 後復發的預後極差，尤其是移植後早期復發者（Dietrich et al. 2011, 2014a）。近 40% 自體 HCT 後復發患者為化療難治性疾病（Dietrich et al. 2014a），且克隆性 TP53 突變盛行率很高（Halldorsdottir et al.

blocks.en: The advance of autologous, CD19-directed CART-cell therapies marked a significant improvement for the treatment of R/R MCL. In patients with prior BTKi exposure, single infusion of Brexucabtagene autoleucel (brexu-cel) resulted in 91% response rate (68% CR) and median PFS of 28.2 month after three years of follow-up (Wang et al. 2023a). Real-world data from the Europe and United states confirmed the excellent outcome with significant proportion of long-term remissions (Iacoboni et al. 2022; Wang et al. 2023b).
blocks.zh: 自體、CD19 導向的 CAR T 細胞療法的進步標誌著 R/R MCL 治療的顯著改善。在先前接受 BTKi 治療的患者中，單次輸注 Brexucabtagene autoleucel (brexu-cel) 的緩解率達 91% (68% CR)，三年追蹤後中位 PFS 為 28.2 個月 (Wang et al. 2023a)。來自歐洲和美國的真實世界數據證實了良好的結果，並且長期緩解的比例很高（Iacoboni 等人，2022 年；Wang 等人，2023b）。

blocks.en: Grade 3 or higher cytokine release syndromes (CRS) and neurologic events occurred in 15% and 31% of patients, respectively. Patients below and above the age of 65 years had similar outcomes after treatment with brexu-cel (Wang et al.
blocks.zh: 3 級以上 cytokine release syndrome（CRS）與神經事件的發生率分別為 15% 與 31%。65 歲以下與以上患者接受 brexu-cel 後的結果相近（Wang et al.

blocks.en: 2023a), suggesting that CAR T-cell treatment can be applied in MCL patients who are not eligible for autologous or allogeneic HCT. Frail patients (ECOG ≥2), however, are more frequently affected by higher grade neurologic toxicities (ICANS) (Wang et al. 2023b). Although much better tolerable than allogeneic HCT cumulative 1-year nonrelapse mortality Brexucabtagene can reach 9.1% in patients with MCL.
blocks.zh: 2023a)，顯示CAR T細胞治療可應用於不適合自體或同種異體HCT的MCL患者。然而，體弱的患者 (ECOG ≥2) 更容易受到高階神經毒性 (ICANS) 的影響（Wang 等人，2023b）。儘管 Brexucabtagene 的耐受性比異體 HCT 好得多，但 MCL 患者的 1 年累計非復發死亡率可達 9.1%。

blocks.en: Due to its better safety profile, CAR T-cell therapy can be considered as the new standard for MCL relapse after ibrutibib treatment. As a consequence, most MCL patients receive CAR T-cell therapy in third line or later, but there is interest in using CAR T-cell therapy in earlier lines. The CARMAN study conducted the European Mantle Cell Lymphoma Network (EMCLN) will investigate the efficacy of CAR T-cells in first line for high-risk patients.
blocks.zh: 由於其更好的安全性，CAR T細胞療法可以被認為是ibrutinib治療後MCL復發的新標準。因此，大多數 MCL 患者在三線或更晚的時間接受 CAR T 細胞治療，但人們對在早期線使用 CAR T 細胞治療感興趣。歐洲套細胞淋巴瘤網絡 (EMCLN) 進行的 CARMAN 研究將調查 CAR T 細胞一線治療高風險患者的療效。

blocks.en: 87.4 Allogeneic HCT In a large EBMT registry study, which investigated the outcome of MCL patients after first-line auto-HCT failure, 24% of all MCL patients received a rescue consolidation HCT. Only a minority of 2% received a second auto-HCT of whom only one patient experienced a long-term survival. These limited results do not justify a rescue auto-HCT as reasonable salvage strategy in this situation. In contrast, the majority of patients who received a second HCT underwent allo-HCT, and a significant proportion of them achieved a durable remission, translating into a 3-year OS of 43% (Dietrich et al. 2014a). Other registry studies and single-center experiences report similar results (Cook et al. 2010; Tam et al.
blocks.zh: 87.4 異體 HCT 一項大型 EBMT 登錄研究評估 MCL 患者第一線自體 HCT 失敗後的結果：24% 接受挽救性鞏固 HCT；僅 2% 接受第二次自體 HCT，且只有一人長期存活，因此不足以支持此策略。相較之下，多數接受第二次 HCT 者採異體 HCT，且相當比例獲得持久緩解，3 年 OS 為 43%（Dietrich et al. 2014a）。其他登錄研究與單中心經驗亦有相似結果（Cook et al. 2010；Tam et al.

blocks.en: 2009; Le Gouill et al. 2012).
blocks.zh: 2009；Le Gouill et al. 2012）。

blocks.en: Long-term efficacy of RIC allo-HCT was recently demonstrated in a large cohort of MCL patients (Robinson et al. 2018). The cumulative incidence of relapse was 40% at 5 years, and OS was 40% at 5 years. Patients who developed a chronic GVHD and/or patients who did not receive an in vivo TCD with CAMPATH had a
blocks.zh: RIC 異體 HCT 的長期療效最近在一大群 MCL 患者中得到證實（Robinson 等人，2018）。 5 年累積復發率為 40%，5 年總存活率為 40%。發生慢性 GVHD 的患者和/或未接受 CAMPATH 體內 TCD 治療的患者

blocks.en: significantly lower relapse rate, suggesting the existence of a graft versus MCL effect. Despite long-term remissions after allo-HCT, chemorefractory disease (Robinson et al. 2018) or early relapse after first-line auto-HCT (Dietrich et al.
blocks.zh: 復發率顯著較低，顯示存在移植物抗 MCL 效應。儘管異體 HCT 可帶來長期緩解，化療難治性疾病（Robinson et al. 2018）或第一線自體 HCT 後早期復發（Dietrich et al.

blocks.en: 2014a) significantly reduced the long-term survival of MCL patients after allo-HCT. CAR-Tcell therapy seems to provide better outcome in this setting, although direct comparison is pending (Iacoboni et al. 2022; Wang et al. 2023a). It is important to note that there is a small group of relapsed MCL patients who survived longer than 5 years even without allo-HCT, suggesting a rather indolent disease course in a subset of patients (Dietrich et al. 2014a). Such patients with a low percentage of Ki67-positive tumor cells might not benefit from an allo-HCT.
blocks.zh: 2014a) 顯著降低了異體 HCT 後 MCL 患者的長期存活率。儘管直接比較仍在進行中，但 CAR-T 細胞療法似乎在這種情況下提供了更好的結果（Iacoboni 等人，2022 年；Wang 等人，2023a）。值得注意的是，有一小部分復發性 MCL 患者即使沒有進行異基因 HCT 也能存活超過 5 年，這表明一部分患者的病程相當惰性（Dietrich 等，2014a）。這些 Ki67 陽性腫瘤細胞比例較低的患者可能無法從異體 HCT 中受益。

blocks.en: Key Points
blocks.zh: 要點

blocks.en: • Ibrutinib improves disease-free survival in addition to intensive induction- and RTX maintenance therapy.
blocks.zh: • 在強化誘導與 RTX 維持治療之外加入 ibrutinib，可改善無疾病存活。

blocks.en: • Auto-HCT in first remission should be questioned in low-risk patients and patients with TP53 mutations not responding to chemotherapy.
blocks.zh: • 低風險患者，以及 TP53 突變且對化療無反應者，首次緩解時是否接受自體 HCT 應審慎評估。

blocks.en: • CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy achieves high remission rates in relapsed and R/R MCL.
blocks.zh: • CD19 定向 CAR T 細胞療法在復發性和 R/R MCL 中實現了高緩解率。

blocks.en: • Early treatment with CAR T-cells is currently evaluated by EMCLN in the CARMAN trial.
blocks.zh: • 目前，EMCLN 在 CARMAN 試驗中評估了 CAR T 細胞的早期治療。

blocks.en: • While curative potential of CART-cell therapy in MCL remains unclear, allo- HCT should be evaluated for MCL patients relapsing after CAR T-cell therapy.
blocks.zh: • CAR T 細胞治療對 MCL 是否具有治癒潛力仍不明；CAR T 細胞治療後復發者應評估異體 HCT。
